report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200 with durations 78-203ms; gateway metrics show zero 502s and p95 ~230ms. Traces show healthy downstream spans (inventory, payment, postgres, redis) with no errors. No evidence supports any taxonomy cause; the alert observations are healthy, so no bounded root cause can be established.
